segments.description: A California community bank serving small- and medium-sized businesses, professionals and individuals with banking, lending, treasury and trust services.
segments.evidence: We are a community bank with one reportable operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest on loans and investments and fees from deposit, treasury, merchant and trust services provided to business and individual customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Net interest income of $460.3 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, increased $12.9 million, or 2.89%, compared to the same period of 2024.

changes.text: In 2025, Citizens Business Bank converted from a California-chartered bank to a national banking association and was renamed Citizens Business Bank, National Association.
changes.evidence: Effective December 15, 2025, the Bank converted from a California-chartered bank to a national banking association chartered under the laws of the United States.
